title: Thought Horror Overfiend (Seasonal)
summary: The seasonal Overfiend combines repeating mental attacks with a late close-range burst.
overview: The seasonal Overfiend combines repeating mental attacks with a late close-range burst.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep recovery available for the 25% pulse and continue handling the spell timers through the finish.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A self-centered dread spell repeats every 20 seconds, while a random-target fracture spell repeats every 35 seconds.
The 50% threshold is an announcement; at 25% the boss deals a direct area-damage pulse within 70 range.
At 10%, the script changes its appearance and adjusts damage-taken skill modifiers.

notes: Approval E351. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The final-stage skill modifiers are labeled as magic vulnerability in comments, but their actual spell-damage effect requires server/database validation.
Resolve the exact NPC template IDs from the zone database before enabling NPC-page links.
